content:
A "run an analysis" / "audit" task produces DOCUMENTATION only — the DB itself is NOT modified in the same commit. Each per-issue fix gets its own commit with owner approval.

Established by manateecreeksheep commit 08e7b6e (docs/pen_3_analysis_2026-04-26.md): 449-line per-animal review found ~20 distinct data issues; commit message explicitly stated "DB unchanged this commit. Any per-issue fix belongs in a separate commit with owner approval."

Rationale (consistent with careful-not-clever):
- Analysis output is a deliverable for the owner to read, not a batch of writes
- Bundling fixes with analysis hides the fixes from owner review
- Some "issues" need owner judgment to resolve (e.g., tag-0029 conflict — owner deferred to index-card review)
- Pre-existing errors should be left as-is unless explicitly authorized

Applies broadly to any review/audit task shape, not just sheep flock.
